basis: Builds on round3/dasp-plan.json (S1 to S11, per_language.it). IT page has no Search Console data yet (launched days ago), so title and opening are free to change. One correction to round3: the ATO DASP page, fetched today, states 'Claiming a DASP will not affect any future visa applications.' The round3 'not verified, soften' note on the visa FAQ is therefore withdrawn for IT: keep the claim and attribute it to the ATO.

target_queries.intent: how to get super back after leaving; head term
Italians call the DASP 'rimborso della super'; needs the word rimborso in title/lede

target_queries.q: DASP come fare richiesta / richiesta DASP online
target_queries.intent: step by step, online vs modulo

target_queries.q: superannuation tassa 65% / quanto si recupera della super

target_queries.intent: claim from home, payment to Italian account

competitors.what_they_have: The only Italian-language result with real substance and our main rival for every IT query: official ATO page in Italian ('Pagamento del contributo pensionistico per partenza dall'Australia', updated 17 June 2026). Headings: Idoneità al DASP; Rintracciare i tuoi contributi pensionistici; Come fare richiesta (domande online, domande cartacee con soglia 5.000 $, autorizzare qualcuno); Ritornare in Australia dopo aver richiesto il DASP; Come e quando viene pagato (28 giorni dal ricevimento della domanda completa); Come viene tassato (tabella 35/45/65%, 'Non includere il DASP nella tua dichiarazione dei redditi'). Weak points we can beat: translated bureaucratic Italian ('contributo pensionistico'), never says 'superannuation' or 'super' in the copy the way people search, no examples of net amounts, no WHM-specific framing, no help with multiple funds or certified copies from Italy.

French community tutorial that also ranks for Italian queries: numbered walkthrough of the online DASP system screen by screen, documents, payment to a foreign account, hundreds of reader comments (freshness signal). We have no visible steps at all.

English backpacker guide ranking for IT query variants: 'do working holiday makers get super', the employer rate, choosing a fund, multiple accounts, then how to claim. Shows the employer super rate figure we do not state on IT.
Eligibility checklist, numbered how-to, 6 month transfer to the ATO, tax rates, start the application before leaving.
Explainer with a tax rate table, processing time, documents, and a 'returning to Australia' answer.
Fund page (Hostplus is the hospitality fund many WHMs end up in): eligibility, ATO online system vs paper form, identity documents, international payment.

gap_summary: No Italian page answers this like a person would. Everyone above has an eligibility checklist, numbered steps, 'start before you leave', the 6 month transfer and a rate table; we have none of the steps, no dated figures, and four live fact errors (28 days 'dall'approvazione', 5.000 $ = copie autenticate, untaxed element 'aliquota più alta', 'senza spese' at the ATO). Fixing those and adding steps plus a sourced key-figures block makes us the most complete Italian answer, ahead of the ATO's translated page.

changes.new_text:
Recuperi la superannuation con il Departing Australia Superannuation Payment (DASP), quando il tuo visto 417 o 462 è scaduto o annullato e hai lasciato l’Australia. La domanda online all’ATO è gratuita. Ai working holiday maker viene trattenuto il 65% della componente imponibile, e il resto può arrivare anche su un conto all’estero, se il tuo fondo lo prevede.

Secondo l’ATO il pagamento arriva in genere entro 28 giorni dal ricevimento della domanda completa. A bloccare una richiesta di solito sono un visto che risulta ancora attivo, un fondo di cui non sapevi niente o documenti d’identità che il fondo non accetta.
changes.why: S1. Answer-first, quotable by AI (Lead is 58 words; both sit inside .hero-sub, the speakable selector). The emotional line stays in the forest CTA section, where it already is.

changes.new_text: Q: 'Perché la tassa sul DASP è così alta per i working holiday maker?' A: 'Perché la legge fissa un’aliquota separata del 65% per la super maturata con un visto 417 o 462, in vigore dal 1° luglio 2017. Se anche una parte del pagamento viene da contributi versati mentre avevi uno di quei visti, il 65% si applica all’intero pagamento. L’unica conseguenza è che i conti si chiudono, quindi se torni a lavorare in Australia ricominci con un nuovo fondo.'

facts.fact: Eligibility: super built on a temporary visa; visa ceased (expired or cancelled); left Australia and no other active Australian visa; not an Australian or NZ citizen or permanent resident.
DASP online application system is free of charge; you can start and save it while still in Australia and submit after leaving.
Paid generally within 28 days of the completed application being received (same wording on the ATO Italian page: 'entro 28 giorni dal ricevimento della domanda completa').
Unclaimed super goes to the ATO when 6 months or more have passed since you left and the visa has ceased; still claimable as a DASP.
Paper applications for balances of $5,000 or more may require a Certification of Immigration Status from Home Affairs, with a fee.
'Claiming a DASP will not affect any future visa applications.' and 'Don't include DASP in your tax return'.

WHM (417/462) DASP withholding 65% on taxed and untaxed elements; others 35% / 45%; tax-free component nil; since 1 July 2017; WHM rate applies to the whole payment if any contributions were made on a 417/462.
Online system: TFN optional; one application per account found; ABN to add an unfound fund; shows submitted status, not fund processing.
Find funds via myGov linked to the ATO: Super, then Fund details; ATO-held super shows there.
Tax refunds are paid only into an Australian bank account.
DASP to an overseas account depends on the fund (e.g. Cbus pays by international transfer and does not accept Revolut or Wise).
NZ citizens cannot claim a DASP; trans-Tasman transfer to KiwiSaver may apply.
Super guarantee 12% of ordinary time earnings since 1 July 2025.
Self-lodged 2025-26 return deadline was 31 October 2026; a late return can still be lodged.
ATO Italian DASP page, headings and Italian terms used as the benchmark competitor (last updated 17 June 2026).
